A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. All 26 pages of each version, including Appendices A–E, support reliable comparison of the text, equations, tables and figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations across six benchmarks, including calibration, goodness-of-fit, cascade performance and runtime results, plus confidence-thresholding results in Appendix E.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Section 4 and Appendix E, including benchmark tables and cascade performance plots.

M1.justification: The Markov-copula model, mixed beta marginals, calibration transformations, threshold objective and optimization procedure are retained. Appendix B's Algorithm 1 is unchanged; the revised optional subcascade discussion does not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate MMLU, MedMCQA, TriviaQA, XSum, GSM8K and TruthfulQA. No dataset, task, domain or test scenario is added or removed, including in the appendices.

E2.justification: Grid search remains the evaluated threshold-selection comparator in Table 7 and Figure 6. Table 2 also retains the same comparison of calibration with and without feature transformations.

E3.justification: The data splits, zero-shot prompting, model lineup, Claude 3.5 Sonnet judging, ECE/AUC metrics and grid-search spacing of 2.5% probability mass remain unchanged in Sections 4.1–4.4.

E4.justification: The feature-transform ablation, Markov-assumption checks, copula and marginal-distribution fit analyses, and Appendix E confidence-thresholding analysis are retained. Their relocation does not introduce new analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions retain B=1000 bootstrap tests, the same significance reporting in Table 7, one-sigma displays in Figures 5–6 and binomial uncertainty bands in Figure 7. No statistical procedure or run-count reporting changes.

E6.justification: The numerical tables and plotted results match after accounting for relocation. For example, Table 7 retains average AUC values of 0.309 for continuous optimization and 0.312 for grid search; Appendix E retains the same conditional-accuracy curves.

T1.justification: Equation (6) changes from an exact equality to an approximation, qualifying the factorization consistently with the approximate Markov assumption in Equation (5). Proposition 2 and its Appendix A proof remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and scope, including improved optimization scaling, the 1.9% average AUC reduction for cascades with at least three models, and the 28.2% calibration-error reduction.

C2.justification: Section 3.3 changes subcascade evaluation from involving 'no additional' computational overhead to 'little' overhead. Section 4.1 also makes the pricing argument explicitly time-dependent and describes directly using the larger model as 'likely preferable,' modestly qualifying the computational-cost interpretation.

D1.justification: The API providers, niagara package, reproduction-code link, optimization settings, Appendix B numerical integration and lookup-table details, and Appendix C prompt templates are retained. No implementation or access information is substantively added or removed.

R1.justification: v2 adds Liu and Nocedal (1989) as a reference for the optimizer discussion in Section 3.3. The GPT-4 Technical Report remains cited despite its shortened author listing; the broader research positioning is unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds author affiliations, standardizes citation formatting, clarifies the point-mass notation in Equation (7), makes small prose edits and redirects decomposition references to main-text Equations (14)–(15). The overall narrative and section organization remain stable.

P2.justification: Most table captions move above their tables, Tables 5–6 are grouped on one page, and Figure 5 and Table 7 become vertically stacked instead of side by side. Algorithm 1 is placed under Appendix B. The existing figures retain their plotted content.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves mathematical precision by marking Equation (6) as approximate, explains previously unexplained point-mass notation and qualifies the subcascade-overhead statement. Clearer equation references and appendix placement also help readability. These are limited gains; the method, proof and empirical support remain substantially unchanged.
